svg.title: Orchestration Route — main GUI runtime map
svg.desc: Document-styled main GUI LangGraph Runtime Map. 19 nodes and 50 displayed connections retain the saved graph and GUI edge filtering. Document-only spacing and larger labels use the shared node normalization and Bezier routing. Solid blue routes are defaults; dashed blue routes are conditional; muted overlays show control, device, evidence and sidecar connections. No live status is shown.
